head_note: sha of the last code commit; this file is committed after it
compile_note: lanes never compile (rule 2026-10-07); orchestrator builds bindings _mojolearn_byte_lm, _mojolearn_transformer, _mojolearn_training, _mojolearn_mamba, _mojolearn_linalg (+ host twins) with each control on and off

neural_gemm_schedule.note: Arms are mutually exclusive by construction. stream_all (NI02) moves every GEMM caller (gemm lane, classical, neural); the other arms only the neural dispatch. bits_change: stream/stream_all/stream_exact/fold_exact/pages/threadmap/cost/async run the selected neural profile (v1 contract leaf unless the leaf control is set); geometry reuses incumbent geometries. ID check required per arm.

phase2_combinations.reason: pre-built combinations of other arms of the same define (NN02+NN11, NN09+NN15); phase 2 only if both parents win on NVIDIA and AMD

neural_gemm_schedule_roles.note: Caller-class scope of neural_gemm_schedule (call-site role tags, never a matrix size): projection = forward and dInput of non-head layers; head = LM head forward and dInput (byte_lm, model pool, offload, samba head loss, transformer LM generation); wgrad = every dWeight/dBias. Only meaningful with a schedule arm other than stream_all; guard refuses a mask with stream_all.
neural_gemm_schedule_roles.prune_note: DEFER phase 2: scope refinement of a schedule arm that has not won yet. When re-enabled use per-lane arms: lm-forward {projection, head}, mlp {projection, wgrad}, train lanes {projection, head, wgrad}

gemm_leaf.note: Scope arm: neural128/neural256 switch the neural callers to the NN03 profile body. The all256 contract-leaf arm (every GEMM, classical too) is split out as gemm_contract_leaf. Leaf 64 deleted (I04 loser). Bit version: ID check per arm.

neural_gemm_chains.note: Former IDN_NEURAL_NN04 enable removed: defining CHAINS is the switch. Excluded with schedule=geometry (guard).

neural_gemm_epilogue.note: mlp arm reaches mlp-train-step; cnn arm is non-board (x_cnn).

neural_gemm_pair.note: Out of this lane's merge list; review proposes IDN_NEURAL_GEMM_GROUP={pair,pack,v2} with NI07. Owed to a follow-up lane.

neural_gemm_workspace.note: Guard keeps it exclusive with MOJOLEARN_NI01_TRAINING_WORKSPACE.

neural_gemm_zero_tail.note: NN16 is only read with neural_gemm_schedule on (stream arms, neural_streaming.mojo:33,216); standalone it reaches the lm-forward head workspace clear (byte_lm_logits.mojo:169).

attn_head_share.note: Only in _launch_fwd_r2 (ATTN_ARM_TRIAL builds) and only for (n_heads/n_kv)%4==0. Board shapes have n_kv==n_heads: never engages on the board; needs a GQA workload. Two-head arm deleted (I06 loser).

attn_softmax.note: online_tile32 (MOJOLEARN_IDN_ATTN_SOFTMAX=2) is the attention-online-tile32.fp32.v2 profile; since lane/attention-tiled-v2 (2026-10-07) its device kernels are the tiled ones in attention_v2_model_device.mojo (forward _forward_tiled: one QK^T and one PV sweep per query tile, 32-key device tiles in a 64-key shared ring, two running words per row; backward _prepare_tiled/_dq_tiled/_dkdv_tiled, all in the contract's fold order), not the one-thread-per-row reference, which remains for the Apple column, the trace-only diagnostic cells and head dims outside {16,32,64}. Host column: attention_v2_model_host.mojo (byte_lm_host_kernels.mojo:931, transformer_oracle.mojo:2057). Bits change vs off/summary_tree (profile), equal on NVIDIA and AMD. Its forward rows-per-block sweep is attn_v2_tq (grid_controls/attention-tiled-v2.json).

attn_stash.note: Off = shipped profile (alias_y automatic on NVIDIA estash, full estash elsewhere). NN19/NN18 ATTN_ARM runtime arms stay a runtime env sweep inside an ATTN_ARM_TRIAL build (MOJOLEARN_ATTN_ARM), not grid dimensions. Build scripts map MOJOLEARN_ATTENTION_MEMORY_PROFILE=recompute|packed|alias-y to arms 1|2|3.

norm.note: lanes8 arms change bits (host oracle and every device column); split_scale and row_block are schedules over the v1 fold (no bit change). row_block does not implement lanes8, hence no lanes8_row_block arm.

phase2_combinations.reason: pre-built combination of lanes8 and split_scale; phase 2 only if both win

train_swiglu.note: Both defines enabled the same training_swiglu launch; NI26's extra flag was assigned and never read (removed).

grouped_projections_v2.note: Read in llama_attention_forward (modeling_llama.mojo:4836), the route of lm-forward, lm-train-step, transformer-forward and samba-*: replaces the q/k/v llama_proj calls (they skip gemm/neural_dispatch). Declared for those lanes in neural-small.json, crossed with neural_gemm_pair/neural_gemm_schedule.

gemm_group_slack.note: NI03. Default slack 8 in IDENTICAL (the group rule doubles a ksplit group while the coarser split still issues slack * S blocks); arm off (`MOJOLEARN_IDN_GEMM_GROUP_SLACK_OFF`) is the old slack 4, arm slack2 kept; MOJOLEARN_IDN_GEMM_GROUP_SLACK_8 is refused (promoted). Schedule only: groups are powers of two aligned at leaf 0 (brief section 5 Lemmas A-C), same contract fold tree, no bit moves; host unchanged. Grid run ge123e6f9 (NVIDIA L40S + AMD MI325X, full board data, one scored run per arm): gemm gaussian NV 69.6 -> 51.7 ms (0.743x), AMD 28.5 -> 28.3 (0.99x, inside the floor), combined 0.857x, NV hash == AMD hash. PROMOTED to the IDENTICAL default by lane/grid-act-2 2026-10-08; numbers at the declaration and in docs/apple-fast/EXPERIMENTS.md. The tiles_body arm (MOJOLEARN_IDN_GEMM_GROUP_TILES_BODY) was deleted by lane/grid-prune 2026-10-07 (OVN N01 noise).

gemm_contract_leaf.note: NI08 contract leaf 256 for every GEMM caller in the build (gemm lane and classical too). Declared for gemm:gemm only; a classical lane that wants it declares it in its own family file. Same define as gemm_leaf: never crossed with it.

neural:lm-train-step.route: byte_lm train step -> dev_tensors linear (gemm.neural_dispatch.identical_gemm_into / GemmWorkspace.run; backward via gemm.neural_backward) + LM head (ROLE_HEAD) -> modeling_llama decoder (eager_attention_forward, llama_rms_norm, rope, swiglu) -> fused attention backward
neural:lm-train-step.notes: Only neural_gemm_schedule=stream neural_gemm_schedule=stream_all neural_gemm_schedule=pages neural_gemm_schedule=fold_exact neural_gemm_schedule=threadmap train_scratch=2 gemm_split_min_leaves=3 reach this lane.

neural:lm-forward.route: byte_lm forward -> modeling_llama decoder + head GEMM (ROLE_HEAD)
neural:lm-forward.notes: Only neural_gemm_schedule=stream neural_gemm_schedule=pages neural_gemm_schedule=fold_exact neural_gemm_schedule=threadmap attn_tile_order=asc gemm_split_min_leaves=3 reach this lane.

neural:transformer-forward.route: transformer binding -> modeling_llama forward (llama_proj -> GemmWorkspace.run ROLE_PROJECTION; eager_attention_forward; llama_rms_norm; rope); no LM head
neural:transformer-forward.notes: Only neural_gemm_schedule=stream neural_gemm_schedule=pages neural_gemm_schedule=fold_exact neural_gemm_schedule=threadmap attn_tile_order=asc gemm_split_min_leaves=3 reach this lane.

neural:samba-train-step.route: python samba step -> training.samba_ops linear (projection/wgrad) + samba_head_loss_host (ROLE_HEAD) + transformer attention block
neural:samba-train-step.notes: Only neural_gemm_schedule=stream neural_gemm_schedule=pages neural_gemm_schedule=fold_exact neural_gemm_schedule=threadmap train_scratch=1 gemm_split_min_leaves=3 gemm_split_min_leaves=2 reach this lane.

neural:mlp-train-step.route: training binding -> training.mlp_ops _gemm (forward/dInput ROLE_PROJECTION, dW ROLE_WGRAD) + fused epilogue (NN06)
neural:mlp-train-step.notes: Only neural_gemm_schedule=stream neural_gemm_schedule=pages neural_gemm_schedule=fold_exact neural_gemm_schedule=threadmap train_scratch=1 reach this lane.

gemm:gemm.route: linalg binding -> gemm/checks/gemm_identical (not the neural dispatch)
gemm:gemm.note: Only gemm_contract_leaf=all256 and neural_gemm_schedule=stream_all reach this lane (plus neural-small.json controls).
